hints.tr: Bağ sütunun tanımına da yazılabiliyor: `order_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id)`.
hints.en: The link can go in the column definition too: `order_id INT NOT NULL REFERENCES orders(id)`.

hints.tr: Ebeveyn silinince çocukların da gitmesi için bağın sonuna `ON DELETE CASCADE`. Onsuz sunucu siparişi silmeyi reddediyor ve notlar yerinde kalıyor; kontrol ikisini de deniyor.
hints.en: For the children to go when the parent is deleted, end the link with `ON DELETE CASCADE`. Without it the server refuses to delete the order and the notes stay; the check tries both.

hints.tr:
Sorgunun tamamı:

```sql
CREATE TABLE order_notes (
    id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id INT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    note NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL
);
```
hints.en:
The whole query:

```sql
CREATE TABLE order_notes (
    id INT IDENTITY(1,1) PRIMARY KEY,
    order_id INT NOT NULL
        REFERENCES orders(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    note NVARCHAR(200) NOT NULL
);
```

checks.query: SET NOCOUNT ON; INSERT INTO order_notes (order_id, note) VALUES (1001, 'call first'), (1001, 'fragile'), (1002, 'gift wrap'); BEGIN TRY DELETE FROM orders WHERE id = 1001; END TRY BEGIN CATCH END CATCH; SELECT order_id, note FROM order_notes ORDER BY id;
SET NOCOUNT ON; BEGIN TRY INSERT INTO order_notes (order_id, note) VALUES (9999, 'no such order'); SELECT 'accepted' AS result; END TRY BEGIN CATCH SELECT 'rejected' AS result; END CATCH
